about.text: teemo.gg served 'Model-Viewer.com': a 3D model viewer ('Zoom, rotate, play animations, hide meshes') for game models from League of Legends, Genshin Impact, Overwatch, Teamfight Tactics and VALORANT, with a Patreon support offer to request models; update log last entry 2022-02-20 and copyright 2021.
